status: Reproduced; repairs pending after in-flight corpus
findings: Actual schema2 plus --modular-cache CLI fails with TypeError: TargetCostModel is passed to mapping-only structural cost. No output emitted.
Actual modular plan with zero checker/time budgets still produces one proposal and invokes checker twice because per-function shares are clamped to one.
Invalid JSON in disposable per-function cache aborts planning instead of becoming a cache miss.
Replanning after combined rejection is not included in reported attempt totals; global budgets need centralized accounting, including replays and retries.
Per-function cache writes are direct rather than atomic; bounded, validated reads and atomic writes should follow existing plan-cache machinery.
Modular CLI omits refresh and alternatives integration used by the ordinary planner; verify equivalent discovery/output behavior while repairing composition.
other_review_notes: Search distinguishes typed syntax, binding-safe match/substitution, candidate ranking, final checker admission and actual measured profitability.
Cached costs and module serializations assume immutable shared bodies, retain objects beside Python ids and are per-search; contextual fact cache must preserve scope if later added.
Candidate diversity and premise-class interleaving preserve search breadth; rejected proofs do not mark target states seen. Memo retention and time/check/memory gates are explicit.
Condition alternatives include normalization, certificates, supporting lemmas and congruence; no hint is admitted without replay. Higher-order generation refreshes intermediate syntax.
Checker sessions reuse admitted supersets and bounded leases, independently replay complete chains and exact closure; pipe error/timeout lifecycle deserves separate audit.

Guard deduplication precomputes initial guard set, while dynamic refresh may add new laws. Current refresh does not synthesize guarded variants; new guarded generation must update this set if enabled.
CLI supports costs, cache replay, egraph, stochastic, modular and streams. Capability combinations need actual integration tests, not merely individual-feature tests.
limitations: No proof bypass established; reproduced failures are planning availability and resource-contract defects.
Generalization/performance changes from repairing modular search have not been measured.
